steps.text: Welcome to MusicServer! Let's take a quick tour.
Database will give you some statistics of your music library and let you browse it by Artist/Album/Song.
Plugins will let you add and configure plugins to import your music library from different sources.
Api Keys allows managing keys for granting access to music APIs from external applications.
Logs is for understanding what's happening inside Music Server. We hope you never need this!
Now, few steps on how to configure the Filesystem Music Plugin to start using Music Server.
Head over the Plugins section and activate the Filesystem Music Plugin by clicking on "Start".
Click on "Configure" and set the path to your music library. Optionally decide whether to optimize your library in case of Artists name case mismatch.
Click on the "Scan" button to analyze your library. The scan of your library will take a while, take a look at notifications to know when it is completed.
Click on "Database" and browse your library. You're done, you just need a plugin for Music Server (e.g. the Volumio one) to enjoy your library!
You're all set. Enjoy Music Server.
